festivals: Ratha Yatra (June-July, with fair at Chitralaya fairground)

history.summary: Local temple dedicated to Jagannath, Balabhadra and Subhadra on Rajendra Prasad Road, B-Zone, Durgapur. Described in local listings as one of the oldest temples in Durgapur; exact founding date unverified (flag). During Ratha Yatra the idols are carried to the Chitralaya fairground for the annual fair, reportedly the biggest Ratha Yatra celebration in Durgapur. Daily prasad is served (low-cost, booking-based). IDENTITY NOTE: this is a local shrine, not related to the new Digha Jagannath Dham (East Midnapore) opened in 2025.

name: Shri Shri Jagannath Temple, Durgapur
town_description: Durgapur is a major industrial city in Paschim Bardhaman district, West Bengal, on the Grand Trunk Road, planned as an industrial township in the 1950s around steel plants and the Durgapur Barrage on the Damodar river.

travel.airport: Kazi Nazrul Islam Airport, Durgapur (Durgapur/Andal) ~15 km; Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose International Airport, Kolkata ~170 km
travel.railway: Durgapur station on the Howrah-Delhi main line; local buses/autos to B-Zone, Rajendra Prasad Road
travel.road: On Rajendra Prasad Road, B-Zone, off NH-19 (old NH-2) Grand Trunk Road through Durgapur.

visitor_information.best_time: Ratha Yatra (June-July) for the fair; otherwise October-March.
visitor_information.opening_hours: Reported hours vary: 5:00 AM-8:00 PM all days (place listing), or 5:00 AM-8:00 PM only Sun-Mon and 5:00 PM-8:00 PM other days (directory). Verify on visit.
